newsitem.title: USA: Youth Services sees Q4 below estimates.
newsitem.headline: Youth Services sees Q4 below estimates.

text.p: Youth Services International Inc said on Tuesday that it expects to report results for the fourth quarter and year ended June 30 below analysts' expectations by $0.10 to $0.14 per share.

According to First Call, the mean analyst estimate for Youth Services fourth quarter earnings is $0.14 a share, compared with $0.11 the previous fourth quarter. The consensus estimate for the year is $0.41 a share versus $0.27.
Youth Services said that it will report non-recurring costs related to the termination of its acquisition of Three Springs Inc and to the early conversion of some convertible debt.
The company also said that it has exercised its option to acquire Introspect HealthCare Corp and that it will record an earnings shortfall for Introspect.

Youth Services said that Introspect's operating results will be less than the management fee income Youth Services had expected through its management contract with the firm, prior to its acquisition.
Introspect results will be consolidated into Youth Service results, which assume that the company had been acquired at the beginnning of the fiscal year.
According to Youth Services, it remains "very optimistic" about its long-term outlook.
